description: The cantina is a broad stone-and-metal room arranged around an oval island bar. Bottles and amber lamps crowd the central counter, with stools circling it on every side. Round tables, small lamps and deep red upholstered booths fill the outer alcoves. On the upper left, a small raised stage is washed in purple light beside a bright sign. The lower entrance carries a large Cantina sign, and barrels and pipes are tucked into the corners near the side passages. The curved bar and repeated booth shapes make the room feel busy even where the open walkways between them remain clear.

landmarks.label: Oval island bar
landmarks.description: An oval bar surrounds shelves of bottles and amber lights, with stools around its edge.

landmarks.label: Purple-lit stage
landmarks.description: A small raised stage and instruments occupy the upper-left alcove beneath violet lighting.

landmarks.label: Outer upholstered booths
landmarks.description: Red booth seating and small tables line the outer alcoves.

landmarks.label: Lower cantina sign
landmarks.description: A large Cantina sign hangs above the painted lower entrance.

landmarks.label: Round lamp-lit tables
landmarks.description: Small round tables and lamps stand between the central bar and the booths.

landmarks.label: Pipe and barrel corner
landmarks.description: Pipes, barrels and industrial details crowd the right-hand corner.
